tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Window and page ground: the darkest step of the warm near-black ladder. Input and select fills, code/diagnostic wells and dialog notes also sit on it.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Title bar (40px header) and the 72px icon rail.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, dialog cards and secondary buttons. Elevation is this fill step plus a 1px `line`, never a shadow.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, rail items, menu items and ghost/secondary buttons; also the neutral badge fill and the dialog icon tile.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rail item and segmented option; the fill of floating layers (menus, popovers, toasts).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px dividers: panel borders, row separators, header and rail edges, dialog footer rule. Decorative separation only (1.16:1 on bg-panel).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons and floating layers: secondary buttons, dialog cards, toasts, popovers; also the scrollbar thumb. Labelled controls only. Form fields use line-control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs and selects, whose outline is the only thing that shows the field. Fields sit only on bg-canvas and bg-panel, where it holds the 3:1 non-text floor (3.3:1 and 3.0:1).

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles. Reads 15.9:1 on bg-canvas, 15.1:1 on bg-sidebar, 14.3:1 on bg-panel, 12.9:1 on bg-hover, 12.0:1 on bg-selected.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dialog descriptions, ghost buttons, field labels, neutral badges, the misfortune pill, idle icons. Reads 7.3:1 on bg-canvas, 7.0:1 on bg-sidebar, 6.6:1 on bg-panel, 6.0:1 on bg-hover, 5.5:1 on bg-selected.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: meta, keys, hints, section titles, empty-state and select-chevron icons. Reads 6.0:1 on bg-canvas, 5.7:1 on bg-sidebar, 5.3:1 on bg-panel, 4.8:1 on bg-hover, 4.5:1 on bg-selected.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The amber of the brand mark's gem: primary button fill, the active rail icon, focus rings, input focus border, checkbox accent. As text (links, key numbers, toast actions) it reads 6.9:1 on bg-panel, 6.2:1 on bg-hover, 5.8:1 on bg-selected; on its own accent-subtle tint 5.5:1 over bg-panel, 5.0:1 over bg-hover. Never decoration.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of the primary button, toast actions and dialog links.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: busy and accent badges, the accent dialog icon tile, the input focus halo, the selected hero chip. Every -subtle fill is the hue at 14%.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent outline: the selected hero chip border, and the text selection highlight. Every -line is the hue at 32%.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent fills (primary button): 7.5:1 on accent, 8.9:1 on accent-hover.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status only: ok badge, success banner and toast icon, active run outcome, rating up. As text it reads 6.3:1 on bg-panel, 5.7:1 on bg-hover; on success-subtle 5.0:1 over bg-panel, 4.6:1 over bg-hover.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of ok badges, active-run pills and success banners.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Border of success banners. Every -line is the hue at 32%.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status only: warn badge, warning banner, toast and confirm-note icon. As text it reads 7.5:1 on bg-panel, 6.8:1 on bg-hover; on warning-subtle 5.8:1 over bg-panel, 5.2:1 over bg-hover.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of warn badges, warning banners and warning notes.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning banners and warning notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status only, for icons and dots: the error banner, toast and dialog icons, the danger confirm-note icon, rating down. Icon contrast 4.7:1 against bg-panel and 3.9:1 against bg-selected (icons need 3:1). Words over a danger fill use danger-text; danger itself falls under 4.5:1 over its own tint.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of danger buttons, bad badges, error banners and danger notes.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of danger buttons, error banners and danger notes, and the danger button's hover fill.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: The label in the danger button and the word in the bad badge, both painted over danger-subtle. Through that tint it reads 6.3:1 over bg-panel and 5.7:1 over bg-hover; through danger-line (the button's hover) 4.8:1 over bg-panel. Bare it reads 7.4:1 on bg-panel and 6.7:1 on bg-hover. Never put it on a solid danger fill.

tokens.name: tier-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze run-outcome pill: text on a 14% tint of itself. Reads 6.4:1 on bg-panel, 5.8:1 on bg-hover; on its tint 5.1:1 over bg-panel, 4.6:1 over bg-hover.

tokens.name: tier-silver
tokens.usage: Silver run-outcome pill. Reads 9.6:1 on bg-panel, 8.7:1 on bg-hover; on its tint 7.1:1 over bg-panel, 6.3:1 over bg-hover.

tokens.name: tier-diamond
tokens.usage: Diamond run-outcome pill. Reads 9.0:1 on bg-panel, 8.2:1 on bg-hover; on its tint 6.7:1 over bg-panel, 6.1:1 over bg-hover. Gold uses accent, misfortune text-2, an active run success.

tokens.name: hero-stelle
tokens.usage: Stelle's hero dot (HeroBadge, charts). Dot and series colour only, never text. From the site's hero table.

tokens.name: hero-mak
tokens.usage: Mak's hero dot and chart series. Never text.

tokens.name: hero-jules
tokens.usage: Jules's hero dot and chart series. Never text.

tokens.name: hero-dooley
tokens.usage: Dooley's hero dot and chart series. Never text.

tokens.name: hero-karnok
tokens.usage: Karnok's hero dot and chart series. Never text.

tokens.name: hero-pygmalien
tokens.usage: Pygmalien's hero dot and chart series. Never text. The dot is 2.8:1 on the chip fill, so the hero code beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: hero-vanessa
tokens.usage: Vanessa's hero dot and chart series. Never text. The dot is 2.6:1 on the chip fill, so the hero code beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: hero-dragons
tokens.usage: The Dragons' hero dot and chart series. Never text.

tokens.name: hero-unknown
tokens.usage: Fallback dot for a hero outside the table; matches the site's FALLBACK_HERO_COLOR.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop behind dialogs; dims without blur.

tokens.name: window-close
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the Windows close button (the platform's own red, with white). Windows only; never elsewhere.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles in the installer and the site. One per page, no eyebrow above it.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, StatusPanel titles and site section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text in both products: descriptions, dialog text, banners, toasts, inputs, site paragraphs.
styles.sample: 完成一局游戏后，战绩会自动出现在这里。

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Panel titles, the product name beside the mark, the primary button label.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Badges, field labels, section labels, sm buttons, segmented options, toast actions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row descriptions, hints, meta and dialog subtitles, in text-2 or text-3.
styles.sample: 保留本地数据与游戏本体。

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Paths, addresses and ports that must be checked character by character.

spacing.note: A 4px scale with two half steps (2 and 6) for tight insides of controls. Every padding and gap is one of these.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Insides of a control: segmented-control inset and gap, header icon group gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Rail item gap, menu padding, key-value action gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons and badges, label to field.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sibling controls: button groups, dialog footer, toasts, field rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Banner, toast and note padding, row vertical padding, dialog body gap, button md side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel and dialog padding, row side padding, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page padding around the installer's main column (40px at the foot).

tokens.name: r-inner
tokens.usage: An element nested inside a control: the checked segment.

tokens.name: r-control
tokens.usage: Anything you click or type into: buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control, menu items, code wells.

tokens.name: r-panel
tokens.usage: Containers: panels, banners, notes, toasts, popovers, rail items, dialog icon tiles.

tokens.name: r-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog cards only.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, hero chips and outcome pills: every 24px label is a full pill.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: dialogs, menus, popovers, toasts. Panels never cast a shadow.

size.note: Fixed dimensions. Every control is one of two heights, every row one height, every icon one of three sizes.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, icon button, input and select height; page-header row; dialog icon tile.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense controls: sm and icon-sm buttons, title-bar icon controls, toast close.

tokens.name: badge-height
tokens.usage: Badges, hero chips and outcome pills.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Every list row: settings rows, key-value rows, disclosure summaries. Content centres vertically, so rows in neighbouring panels line up.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in sm and icon-sm buttons and inside badges or selects.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in md buttons, banners, toasts, menus and dialog tiles.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Rail icons and StatusPanel marks.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: The app's own title bar; macOS reserves 78px on its left for the traffic lights.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Icon rail column; items are 60 × 56px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the installer's main column.

motion.note: Hover and press use t-fast; anything entering (routes, dialogs, menus, toasts) uses t-base. All collapse to 1ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The one easing curve: every transition and entrance.

tokens.name: t-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and colour changes.

tokens.name: t-base
tokens.usage: Entrances: route fade-in, dialogs, menus, toasts.
